steps.content: The exhaustion from the fire, the fleeing, and the horrors you've witnessed has pushed you to your absolute limit, both in body and mind.
The military cot feels impossibly soft. Almost instantly, you are pulled down into a deep, dreamless sleep.

steps.speaker: Unknown Voice
steps.content: ...So your identity was fake all along.

steps.speaker: Unknown Voice
steps.content: Then you must be the mole. Die now!
(Sound of knife stabbing flesh + red flash)
